acceptanceCriteria: query.go and batch_input.go refuse, with the per-path git-output-exceeded message, a path whose parent tree exceeds MaxTreeBytes, covered by a git mktree fixture test
batched and per-path outputs are byte-equal for that fixture
body:
Residual from the V1-1991 Codex round (bugs-residuals lane, PR 1386, 2026-10-21). The batched symbol-anchor and CEM projection reads now use gitauth.ResolvePathLookups and admit a path only when its per-path LookupTreeEntry cost is within MaxTreeBytes. The earlier V1-1984 ResolvePaths consumers in internal/doccorpus/query.go and batch_input.go still check only the 32 MiB aggregate bound, so a path under a parent tree larger than MaxTreeBytes (for example about 4.25 MiB, built with git mktree) can be answered where the per-path lookup refuses with git-output-exceeded.
Expected: every ResolvePaths consumer keeps per-path admission parity, or the spec records why aggregate admission is sufficient there.

title: doccorpus query and batch input admit ResolvePaths results with only the 32 MiB aggregate bound, not the per-path tree bound
